description:
Resource-level state operations:
- import: Bring an existing cloud resource under Terraform management (requires address + id)
- taint: Mark a resource for recreation on next apply (requires address)
- untaint: Remove the taint mark (requires address)
- refresh: Sync state with real infrastructure (accepts drift into state)

address.description: Resource address, e.g. aws_instance.web (required for import/taint/untaint)

id.description: Cloud provider resource ID for import, e.g. i-0abcd1234 or an Azure resource ID

workdir.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory containing .tf files

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to use (default: current workspace)

name: tf_resource
